whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging purposes, not recommended for production use.

devices.title: Cameras
devices.description: Reolink cameras, doorbells, and NVRs. Each entry is one Baichuan host.

host.title: Host
host.description: Camera or NVR IP address or hostname.

password.title: Password
password.description: Baichuan login password. Stored in the plugin config and never written to the log.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional name used for a single camera, or as a prefix for each NVR channel.

uid.title: UID
uid.description: Reolink UID. Required for UDP battery cameras.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: Baichuan transport. Use udp for battery cameras.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: NVR or Hub channel numbers to expose. Leave empty to expose every online channel.

profile.title: Stream profile
profile.description: Baichuan stream proxied to Matter. sub is the default.

eventHoldSeconds.title: Event hold seconds
eventHoldSeconds.description: How long an occupancy sensor stays occupied after a detection. Range 1 to 300.

batteryPollSeconds.title: Battery poll seconds
batteryPollSeconds.description: How often battery cameras are polled. 0 disables polling. Pushed battery events are still applied.

push.title: Asleep event push
push.description: Optional intake for battery cameras that cannot keep a Baichuan event socket open. none uses the native socket only.

configurePush.title: Write push settings to the camera
configurePush.description: When enabled, the plugin writes the bridge address into the camera SMTP or HaCfg webhook settings. Leave disabled unless you want those camera settings changed.

emailPushPort.title: Email push port
emailPushPort.description: SMTP port for battery-camera email alerts.

webhookPort.title: Webhook port
webhookPort.description: HTTP port for Baichuan HaCfg wake and sleep posts.

emailPushDomain.title: Email push domain
emailPushDomain.description: Virtual domain used in the camera recipient address cam-<id>@domain.
